title: Mini Digital Camera $10 (Was $25), Construction Block Wireless Speaker $4, 4in1 Light $9.50 + Del ($0 OnePass/ C&C) @ Kmart
body:
Deal: Mini Digital Camera $10 (Was $25), Construction Block Wireless Speaker $4, 4in1 Light $9.50 + Del ($0 OnePass/ C&C) @ Kmart

[Pikaloo] is this better than the fujifilm x-m5 deal?
[shxhshzhz] 1% of the price and it can still take a picture
[WatchNerd] And the Donut Speaker is cheaper than some fancy donuts.
[videoman] Any details on the microsd card included? It's that cheaper than you can buy a 32gb microsd these days?
[Frackingiscool] It will be a $2 Alibaba microSD card that will last at least until you open the box, maybe longer.
[TheDukeOfNukem] So far it's held up for a few months in the camera as our three year old picks it up and takes some photos every now and then. Can't complain, I guess.
[Big L] The 32GB micro SD card is almost worth the $10
[OnlyHans] Don't forget the included keychain, lanyard, charge & data cable, and user manual.
I'm really looking forward to the user manual.
[Frackingiscool] "If zoom requiring be made, step closer.
If when large person or tree photo requiring, take many steps for opposing direction.
Device not certified for colonoscopy.
Charge device no more when warning fire appears.
Enjoy many happy Anko products."
[OnlyHans] Device not certified for colonoscopy.
I'm out.
[Frackingiscool] @OnlyHans: It only said not certified.
It's capability is your determination.
[OnlyHans] @Frackingiscool: For $10 I expect my colonoscopy photography to be certified.
If I want uncertified colonoscopy photography I'll just continue to ask strangers walking past my house.
[Frackingiscool] @OnlyHans: That's way better than me parting cheeks behind reversing cars at the proctologists hoping one of them can give me a 2nd opinion via reversing camera
[McFly] @OnlyHans: Fortunately, so is the camera.
[joeyg4343] My thoughts too. I usually just buy this junk give it to my kids. It breaks and then I get annoyed at it being in the house for years
Instead of buying I will just do a Haikou
Cheap crap fills my house.
The bargain I can't resist.
The problem is me.
[shalala] Interesting post. Didn't know digital cameras/video recorders of this price point exist.
[WatchNerd] Nice find, it's actually the Space Shuttle.
[RickyJ] "Colour temperature range: 7300-7900K"
Yikes. No mention of colour temperature on the 9.50 lamp. I didn't order one because it looks cold white.
[shxhshzhz] warm white LED
Colour temperature: 3000K±300K.
[Newbie2021] Thanks OP, ordered the camera. Hope it gets delivered.
[cerealsmok3r] got the mini digital camera when it first came out and its pretty fun to use. dont use it as often but it was nice carrying it and taking random pics here and there. good fun if you like a slightly vintage grainy look aka lower res
[Kunny] Great deal on bluetooth speaker with wireless charging magnetic stand ($9 delivered with onepass)
https://www.kmart.com.au/product/wireless-charging-speaker-4…
[jace88] I assume the camera quality is absolutely rubbish but kids might get a kick out of it?
[shxhshzhz] Not absolutely rubbish. Works ok for $10 based on this Ozbargainer's review
[Morven] What about the $15 video camcorder! (720p) Also available in pink.
